title: Proof Gradient
canonical_line: One agent tries. Proof decides. The network evolves.
doctrine: No proof, no evolution. No eval, no propagation. No rollback, no release.

systems.name: Artifact Vault
systems.meaning: Versioned goals, plans, skills, tools, policies, evals, rubrics, context recipes, routing rules, approval rules, and release rules.

systems.name: Run Fabric
systems.meaning: Runs resolve active artifacts, create run contracts, execute deterministic or provider-backed agents, and emit trace events.

systems.name: Proof Ledger
systems.meaning: Append-only evidence: traces, scores, evals, tool decisions, credit assignment, patches, canaries, and rollback drills.

systems.name: Selection Gate
systems.meaning: Candidates must beat baselines, pass safety gates, receive canary routing, and preserve rollback.

proofs.title: Proof #1 — Sovereign Swarm
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic large multi-agent coordination lattice.

proofs.title: Proof #2 — Evolution Tournament
proofs.subtitle: Candidates compete against baselines; only proven artifacts earn canary.

proofs.title: Proof #3 — Recursive Evolution Ladder
proofs.subtitle: Selected artifacts become the next baseline; unsafe evolution is rejected and rolled back.

proofs.title: Proof #4 — Corporate RSI Dominion
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic corporate-domain recursive self-improvement system for the AI-first enterprise era.

evidence.positioning: corporate-domain RSI for the AI-first enterprise era
evidence.claim_boundary: All value numbers are deterministic synthetic enterprise value-index units, not dollars, not revenue, and not investment advice.
